label: Binary check gain is bounded and vanishes exactly on non-discriminating outcomes
paraphrase: For any two outcome weights w and 1-w and conditional truth probabilities u and v in [0,1] for one binary target, using their pooled prior, expected reduction of optimal squared error is w(1-w)(u-v)^2. It is nonnegative, no greater than initial optimal error, which is at most 1/4, and zero exactly when an outcome has zero weight or the two conditional probabilities coincide.
